nodes.label: .`every write without a session is 401 unauthenticated`()
.`every write without the XSRF header is 403 forbidden and changes nothing`()
.`an unknown JSON property is 400 validation-failed on every write`()
.`a profile reference that mixes variants or has unknown properties is 400 validation-failed`()
.`duplicating Balanced is 201 with Location, models missing from the catalog kept (AC-213)`()
.`the chain order is the order sent, position 1 is the main model (AC-213)`()
.`a model missing from the catalog is refused when it does not come from the source (AC-213, AC-221)`()
.`a duplicate from another Owner's or an unknown profile is 404 not-found (AC-222)`()
.`an empty or blank name is 400 name-required (AC-214)`()
.`a name over 40 characters after trimming is 400 name-too-long, exactly 40 is fine (AC-214)`()
.`a name equal to one of my profiles ignoring case is 400 name-taken, another Owner's name is free (AC-214)`()
.`a system profile name, in any case, is 400 name-reserved (AC-214)`()
.`two parallel creates of the same name give one 201 and one 400 name-taken (AC-214)`()
.`an empty text slot, or a body without slots text, is 400 text-slot-required (AC-215)`()
.`a model that cannot do the slot's job is 400 model-not-capable at its index (AC-216)`()
.`a fourth model is 400 slot-full and a repeated model is 400 model-duplicate (AC-217)`()
.`every broken rule is reported at once in errors (AC-214, AC-215, AC-216)`()
.`creating the 21st custom profile is 409 profile-limit-reached, the 20th is fine (AC-218)`()
.`without a provider key create and update are 409 ai-not-configured (AC-226)`()
.`a custom profile is replaced in full, in the chosen order (AC-213)`()
.`saving a profile under its own name, in another case, is allowed (AC-214)`()
.`an update breaking the rules is 400 with errors and keeps the stored profile (AC-214 to AC-217)`()
.`only a newly added missing model is refused, an older missing one stays marked Not in the catalog (AC-221)`()
.`changing or deleting a system profile is 409 system-profile-read-only (AC-219)`()
.`deleting the default custom profile returns the default to Balanced and says so (AC-220)`()
.`deleting a profile that is not the default leaves the default alone (AC-220)`()
.`another Owner's profile, an unknown uuid and a malformed key give 404 not-found on PUT and DELETE (AC-222)`()
.`switching the default to Careful answers 200 with the profile and every option has a price (AC-51)`()
.`the default can be a custom profile and go back to Balanced (AC-51)`()
.`a body without profile is 400 validation-failed with profile required (AC-51)`()
.`a profile with no text model in the catalog cannot become the default, 409 no-text-model (AC-223)`()
.`another Owner's or an unknown profile as the default is 404 not-found (AC-222)`()
